Dutiyauppādasutta Arising (2nd)

Sāvatthinidānaṁ. At Sāvatthī.

“Aṭṭhime, bhikkhave, dhammā bhāvitā bahulīkatā anuppannā uppajjanti, nāññatra sugatavinayā. “Mendicants, these eight things don’t arise to be developed and cultivated apart from the Holy One’s training. Katame aṭṭha? What eight? Seyyathidaṁ—sammādiṭṭhi …pe… sammāsamādhi. They are: right view, right purpose, right speech, right action, right livelihood, right effort, right mindfulness, and right immersion. Ime kho, bhikkhave, aṭṭha dhammā bhāvitā bahulīkatā anuppannā uppajjanti, nāññatra sugatavinayā”ti. These are the eight things that don’t arise to be developed and cultivated apart from the Holy One’s training.”

Pañcamaṁ.
